text:
maria: Heads up — Oxbridge RFP just landed. They want a capability matrix + POC acceptance criteria + attachments index by EOD Friday. I uploaded an initial matrix but need SE confirmation on HSM/KMS options, data residency guarantees, and realistic latency targets for their L2 throughput. @tom can you confirm? Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/oxbridge-capability (internal)
 tom: On it. Quick clarification — are they planning Dedicated or Private deployment? HSM story differs. Also need to know target QPS / tokens per minute so I can map to node counts. For latency: what p50/p95 are they expecting for ~4k token inference? That changes the hardware recommendation.
 sofia: I chatted with their solutions lead — they want Private (VPC + on-prem gateway) and customer-managed KMS. They explicitly asked for FIPS 140-2 HSM compatibility. POC scope they requested: 2-week functional validation + 1 week perf soak.
 evan: Perf reality check: 50ms p50 for 4k tokens is not achievable on our current A100 config. For Private with aggressive batching we can hit ~150ms p50 (p95 ~400ms). If they accept quantized 8-bit model builds and reduced context caching we can maybe get to ~90-120ms p50. I'll add measured numbers to the matrix.
 jen: Legal note — we can sign their DPA but need their SCC addendum and specifics on logging/PII. For POC please use masked logs and a separate test tenant. I'll draft the security questionnaire answers and the minimum contractual asks for HSM/KMS.
 rb-docbot: Uploaded file: /attachments/oxbridge-capability-matrix-v1.xlsx (internal). Metadata: uploader=rb-docbot, size=78KB.
 maria: Thanks. Two asks from sales: 1) who will own on-call during the POC (SE vs SRE) and 2) they want a back-of-envelope POC credit + committed Dedicated pricing if the POC validates. Can we get a rough 3-month baseline pricing for 100K tokens/day and a Dedicated pool estimate?
 tom: I'll assemble a POC resource plan + rough pricing (node counts, infra hours, estimated token costs). ETA: tomorrow morning. For HSM support we can do AWS CloudHSM or an on-prem HSM via PKCS#11 bridge — I'll add both options with caveats.
 sofia: :thumbsup: I'll prepare the runbook (installation steps, test prompts, acceptance criteria) and an attachments index. Recommend including: matrix, runbook, perf harness script, sample prompts, SRE runbook snippet.
 evan: I'll add the canary deployment circuit, autoscale thresholds, and expected cooldowns. FYI default Dedicated autoscale cooldown is 5m; for the POC we can request infra to shorten to 2m to validate scale behavior, but that needs approval.
 maria: Action items recap — Tom: pricing + resource plan; Evan: perf measurements + autoscale proposal; Jen: security questionnaire draft + DPA caveats; Sofia: runbook + attachments index. Let's aim to finalize the package by EOD Friday (timestamp target: 1719124899). Please drop file links in this thread when ready.
 tom: Got it. Will ping with the draft spreadsheet and pricing notes.
 sofia: Adding runbook to attachments now, will post link.
 rb-docbot: Uploaded file: /attachments/oxbridge-runbook-v1.md (uploader=rb-docbot, size=22KB).
 maria: Great progress — thanks everyone. If anyone hits major blockers (HSM integration tests failing, or legal shows red on log retention) call it out here and we'll escalate to solutions leadership. :pray:
